scope: Public-source metadata registry for popular singer groups, with GIRLGROUP as a controlled source/category label.
category_definition: A music group whose members are primarily women; popularity must be measured with a stated metric and date rather than assumed.

source_cause_schema.basis: publicly documented group composition and music-industry classification

location_schema.private_location_policy: Do not infer private residence or current location.

legal_boundary: Do not infer criminality, intent, or wrongdoing from popularity, group membership, metadata, associations, geography, or automated keyword matches. Legal claims require an identified source and evidence status.
neural_boundary: Do not infer neural activity, mental state, or cognitive state from music, performance, social-media activity, avatars, or AR/VR participation.
source_requirements: Prefer official artist/group/label sources, chart organizations, certification bodies, reputable datasets, and dated reporting.
Record the exact metric and measurement date for any popularity claim.
Keep public professional associations separate from private relationships.
note: This is a research schema and representative entity registry, not an exhaustive real-time ranking of all girl groups worldwide.
